question:
Simplify the following:

((2)/(9)) x ((27)/(10)) + ((6)/(5) - 5)
solution:
**Given:**

dfrac{2}{9} times dfrac{27}{10} + dfrac{6}{5} - 5

**Formula used:**

Basic arithmetic operations for fractions

**Calculation:**

dfrac{2}{9} times dfrac{27}{10} + dfrac{6}{5} - 5

⇒ dfrac{(2 times 27)}{(9 times 10)} + dfrac{6}{5} - 5

⇒ dfrac{54}{90} + dfrac{6}{5} - 5

⇒ dfrac{3}{5} + dfrac{6}{5} - 5

⇒ dfrac{(3+6)}{5} - 5

⇒ dfrac{9}{5} - 5

⇒ dfrac{9}{5} - dfrac{25}{5}

⇒ dfrac{(9-25)}{5}

⇒ dfrac{-16}{5}

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
